# Mountaineering royalty schedule 2026

Peaks from 7,001 m to 7,500 m, per foreign climber:

| Peak | Height | Royalty 2026 |
|---|---|---|
| Spantik | 7,027 m | USD 1,370 |
| Diran | 7,266 m | USD 1,520 |

The liaison officer fee is waived on peaks below 7,500 m. Fees are paid to the regional tourism department before the expedition starts.
